run_insecure_local_interop_tests: run the InsecureLocalInteropTest class to test gRPC async interoperability over an insecure channel
run_secure_local_interop_tests: run the SecureLocalInteropTest class to test gRPC async interoperability over an SSL-secured channel
test_empty_unary_call: test the empty unary RPC case using InteropTestCaseMixin.test_empty_unary with a gRPC stub
test_server_streaming_call: test the server streaming RPC case using InteropTestCaseMixin.test_server_streaming with a gRPC stub
test_custom_metadata: test custom metadata handling in gRPC async calls using InteropTestCaseMixin.test_custom_metadata
